meta_data.base_class: Checks if the weather is suitable for an outdoor BBQ on <a specific day>. - applicable for querying weather for an outdoor BBQ in a specific postal code area, sensitive to maximum temperature and rain probability thresholds.

tool_template.name: OutdoorBBQWeatherCheck_<class>
tool_template.description: Checks if the weather is suitable for an outdoor BBQ on <class>.

postalCode.description: The postal code of the area for the weather check.

maxTemperature.description: The maximum temperature threshold for a suitable BBQ on <class>.

rainProbability.description: The maximum acceptable rain probability percentage.

windSpeedThreshold.description: The maximum wind speed in km/h that is acceptable for an outdoor BBQ on <class>.

humidityLevel.description: The maximum acceptable humidity level percentage for a suitable BBQ on <class>.

uvIndexLimit.description: The maximum UV index level considered safe for an outdoor BBQ on <class>.

timeOfDay.description: The preferred time of day for the BBQ on <class>. Options include 'Morning', 'Afternoon', and 'Evening'.
